jobs.title: Software Engineer, Android
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking talented experienced engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products that connect billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Android Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build innovative application experiences
* Implement custom user interfaces using latest programming techniques and technologies
* Analyze and optimize code for quality, efficiency, and performance, and provide feedback to peers during code reviews
* Set direction and goals for teams, lead major initiatives, provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, and help onboard new team members
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt
* Work on a variety of coding languages and technologies
* Establish ownership of components, features, or systems with expert end-to-end understanding

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Shipped at least one large-scale product to production, supporting millions of active users
* Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
* Experience building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit testing techniques
* 2+ years experience building Android applications in Java using Android SDK
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$183,997/year to $257,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Build product interfaces, backend systems, and internal tools for a reinforcement learning data platform. You will own experiences that help research teams and external partners create, evaluate, and improve training data, working closely with research, operations, and go-to-market teams.

* Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js.

* Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, as well as dashboards, monitoring tools, or observability interfaces.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging.

Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for qualified full-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California. Singapore-based and remote candidates with substantial overlap with San Francisco or Singapore time zones may also be considered.

Compensation Range: $130K - $225K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Platform - Serving (US)
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash's ML Serving Platform delivers **tens of millions of predictions per second**, powering search, recommendations, advertising, delivery estimates, and logistics across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

Our customers are modelers and engineering teams across our internal business verticals. We build self-serve infrastructure that empowers them to bring new models into production, adopt open source software and models, and expand what they can accomplish with machine learning at scale.

We work at the intersection of a rapidly evolving open source ecosystem and demanding production workloads. With active customer demand and growing modeling ambitions, we're advancing the infrastructure behind today's predictions while building the capabilities that enable the next generation of ML innovation.

**About the Role**
------------------

You'll help build the next generation of our ML serving platform, connecting request routing and online feature retrieval with model inference on CPU and GPU infrastructure. You'll tackle challenging infrastructure problems involving latency, reliability, resource efficiency, and scale, and make those capabilities accessible through self-serve tools and workflows.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, you'll own defined projects from technical design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production support. You'll partner directly with internal teams to understand emerging modeling requirements, remove adoption barriers, and turn advances in open source technology into measurable production improvements.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Empower modelers through self-serve infrastructure.** Build tools, APIs, and workflows that help internal teams deploy, configure, validate, and operate models independently, accelerating ML adoption across business verticals.
* **Bring open source innovation into production.** Evaluate and integrate evolving inference frameworks and enable open source models, translating promising capabilities into reliable, efficient services at scale.
* **Solve demanding inference infrastructure problems.** Improve the systems that route prediction requests, retrieve online features, and execute models on a platform serving tens of millions of predictions per second.
* **Help evolve our disaggregated serving architecture.** Build modular components that allow routing, feature retrieval, and model execution to evolve and scale independently as workloads and modeling requirements change.
* **Improve Kubernetes deployment and autoscaling.** Help workloads respond to changing traffic while meeting latency and availability requirements and using CPU and GPU resources efficiently.
* **Make adoption and rollout easier.** Build integrations, validation, and migration tooling that help teams adopt new serving capabilities and our unified global platform with confidence.
* **Own performance and reliability in production.** Use benchmarking, profiling, metrics, and tracing to identify bottlenecks; participate in on-call and improve automation and runbooks to make the platform easier to operate.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have **2+ years of software engineering experience** building and maintaining production services or infrastructure.
* You have strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in a backend or systems programming language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, C++, or Python.
* You understand distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, networking, timeouts, failure handling, and performance trade-offs.
* You enjoy challenging infrastructure problems and can independently turn a defined problem into a technical design, tested implementation, and safe production rollout.
* You have experience debugging production systems and using operational data to improve reliability, performance, or cost.
* You care about the engineers using your platform and collaborate effectively with customers and partners to make complex infrastructure easier to adopt.
* You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with ML inference infrastructure, online feature retrieval, or other latency-sensitive distributed services.
* Experience operating containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including deployment, resource management, or autoscaling.
* Experience building self-serve developer platforms, APIs, or automation that helps other engineers move faster.
* Experience integrating open source infrastructure or models and validating their behavior under production workloads.
* Familiarity with CPU/GPU performance profiling, inference runtimes, or model deployment workflows.

**Relevant Technologies and Keywords**

Open source inference runtimes and models, NVIDIA Triton, ONNX Runtime, Kubernetes, CPU/GPU inference, gRPC, online feature stores, distributed systems, performance profiling, autoscaling, and self-serve ML infrastructure.

Familiarity with every technology is not expected. We welcome engineers with strong backend and infrastructure fundamentals who are excited to learn the ML serving ecosystem.

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspect

jobs.title: Contract Student Worker - Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Zoox**

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

**About Our Contract Student Worker Program**

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

### **Role Overview**

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the cross-functional engineering team to prepare and refine raw datasets, ensuring high data quality and pipeline integrity. You will assist in training and fine-tuning machine learning models using industry-standard frameworks and modern architectures. Additionally, you will validate model performance against rigorous benchmarks to ensure production readiness, reliability, and accuracy before deployment.

### **Responsibilities**

* Review data labeling quality
* Help other engineers on model training experiments
* Validate the model results with detailed triages

### **Required Qualifications**

* Python proficiency
* Machine learning
* Computer vision
* Robotics

### **Bonus Qualifications**

C++

### **Program Requirements**

* Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
* Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
* Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
* Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
* Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a research and engineering team building privacy and anonymization systems for sensitive data used in AI training. You will help protect personal and confidential information while preserving the structure and utility of data for downstream workflows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build systems to detect personally identifiable information, quasi-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive content, then select transformations suited to the data and its intended use.
* Develop and benchmark detection methods that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers, and language models.
* Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it reaches processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data workflows.
* Create evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re-identification attempts.
* Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields.
* Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical policies and safeguards.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience building production data or machine learning systems in Python, with strong Python proficiency.
* A technical education or equivalent technical background, and experience building end-to-end data processing pipelines.
* Hands-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful characteristics, using information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods.
* Experience benchmarking detection methods and evaluating recall, precision, latency, cost, and downstream data utility.
* Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation.
* Experience designing systems resilient to schema drift, unusual data formats, and processing edge cases.
* Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format-preserving encryption is valuable.
* Experience with high-throughput or low-latency inference, sensitive data in areas such as healthcare, finance, or security, or taking research systems into production is also valuable.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

Compensation Range: $130K - $225K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomy Safety Metric
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced engineer to join the Behavior Evaluation team and play a pivotal role in measuring the safety of Zoox’s autonomous driving technology. The Behavior Evaluation is the team behind the behavioral part of Zoox’s estimate, quantifying how often the autonomy stack causes the vehicle to stop unexpectedly and how that maps to collision risk. As a member of this team, you will own and scale the pipeline behind these numbers, driving innovation in ML model scoring, sampling, and projections while making the system faster, more reliable, and easier to audit. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers and researchers in a fast paced, collaborative environment as Zoox expands to more cities and software releases.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Build and maintain the Behavior Evaluation data pipelines (PySpark/zspark medallion architecture on Databricks, EMR Serverless and Airflow) that produce weekly per-geofence estimates.
* Turn the statistical method (sampling, triage weights, mileage sharing, projections) into tested, reproducible code with checks that fail loudly when the data is bad.
* Build tools that cut the manual work in each weekly run.
* Work with cross functional stakeholders so the methodology is applied consistently in code and in clearance reports.
* Help adapt to new release methodologies and new geofences.

### **Qualifications:**

* 7 - 9 Years of experience or 5+ years with a strong data-platform track record
* Expert Python, with production experience in PySpark/Spark and Pandas
* Experience designing scalable batch data pipelines: orchestration, Delta/lakehouse tables, idempotent backfills
* Solid grounding in applied statistics: sampling, weighting, estimators, confidence intervals
* Strong testing and CI habits for data code

### **Bonus Qualifications:**

* Experience with autonomous-vehicle simulation, safety metrics or triage workflows
* Experience putting ML models into production in a data pipeline
* Experience with Databricks and AWS (EMR Serverless, S3)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Apple Ads
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something. Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
  
  
Description
  
  
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
* Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
* Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.

jobs.description:
**The opportunity**
-------------------

Unity is building next-generation intelligence systems for gaming: systems that help AI-native teams understand the market and get the most out of the frontier models.

We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead this effort. You will own the end-to-end architecture, build pipelines, systems, and models, and scale a cross-disciplinary team of engine developers, game developers, and machine learning engineers. The work spans market forecasting, outcome prediction, multimodal content understanding, evaluation, and agentic systems.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

### **Technical Excellence**

* Work on our Game Intelligence ML platform, from data ingestion, semantic layer and feature stores through model registry, evaluation and serving.
* Make the calls that keep every model output reproducible and auditable: versioned data snapshots, model and prompt versions, and cost tracked per decision.
* Define, lead, and spearhead engineering practices for the agentic era, including agentic development workflows and evaluation methodologies.
* Partner with different functional teams and disciplines to translate expert human judgment into training signals. Shape the roadmap with the product team.

### **Modeling**

* Build predictors of commercial outcomes for games such as user acquisition cost, lifetime value and return on ad spend from large, noisy, multi-source signals.
* Build forecasting models over market signals that detect emerging demand and estimate when a window opens, peaks and closes.
* Deliver every prediction as a calibrated range with stated confidence, and own the ranking and portfolio logic that turns predictions into recommendations within a budget.

### **Experimentation and agentic systems**

* Design online experimentation with guardrails, safe exploration and clear human decision points.
* Build evaluation harnesses for LLM-based agents, including automated playtesting and multimodal assessment of generated content.
* Orchestrate frontier-model agents in production with strict data boundaries and cost control.

### **Calibration and measurement**

* Own the feedback loop that scores predictions against realized outcomes and corrects bias, coverage and signal weighting over time.
* Make the system report its own error in plain language so that creators and internal stakeholders can trust it.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Passion for game industry
* Deep experience in Game, Game Engine development or Game publishing.
* Experience in machine learning with a track record of owning production ML systems or Agentic systems end to end, from data to serving to measured business outcome.
* Deep experience in performance marketing or ad-tech modeling: predicting acquisition cost, lifetime value, return on ad spend, retention or comparable outcomes.
* Strong grounding in probabilistic prediction and calibration: quantile or interval prediction, coverage, bias correction and backtesting of forecasts.
* Experience building LLM-based agent systems in production: orchestration, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model versioning, and cost control.
* Comfort building in a zero-to-one environment.

**You might also have**
-----------------------

* Experience in mobile game user acquisition, LiveOps or monetization, on the studio or publisher side.
* Experience with Unity game engine, or with automated and bot-driven playtesting.
* Time-series and demand forecasting experience over noisy, multi-source market signals.
* Experience with the Claude Agent SDK, Codex or similar frameworks for multi-agent software production.
* Hands-on experience with BigQuery, ClickHouse, Kafka, Postgres, pgvector or their equivalents.
* Publications or open-source contributions in forecasting, causal inference, calibration or agentic systems.

jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Researcher

**General Summary:**

Qualcomm AI Research is seeking world-class researchers to help push the boundaries of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Our team pioneers new algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art while delivering exceptional performance with unprecedented power, memory, and computational efficiency.

  

Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across algorithms, software, hardware, and systems. We pursue fundamental and applied research, from foundational theories and novel learning algorithms to efficient AI systems deployed on resource-constrained devices. Working closely with Qualcomm's business and engineering teams, we translate research breakthroughs into technologies deployed worldwide across mobile, compute, automotive, robotics, cloud, XR, and IoT platforms, while publishing at leading AI conferences.

  

Our team has demonstrated world-first research breakthroughs and proof-of-concepts across model efficiency, representation learning, perception and understanding, generative and foundation models, reasoning and agentic intelligence, and embodied and physical AI. Our research contributions have earned numerous best paper awards, major research competition wins, and top rankings on AI and computer vision benchmarks. We also translate these breakthroughs into highly optimized AI models, end-to-end workflows, and developer tools for Qualcomm platforms, making many innovations accessible to all. Explore our research and innovations:

* Research Breakthroughs and Demonstrations
* Qualcomm AI Research Publications and Innovations
Qualcomm AI Hub: Optimized Models and Workflows  

  

**Role Responsibilities:**

Research interns will contribute to fundamental and applied research in artificial intelligence and machine learning, developing novel algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art. Research opportunities span a broad range of areas, including:

* **Generative AI and Foundation Models:** Large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, vision-language models (VLMs), vision-language-action models (VLAs), world models, and generative modeling for language, image, video, audio, and 3D content. Research topics include diffusion and autoregressive models, mixture-of-experts, parallel decoding, long-context modeling, and knowledge distillation.
* **Agentic AI and Reasoning:** Autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, reasoning, planning, and verification; memory management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), inference-time optimization, robustness, alignment, AI safety, and hallucination mitigation.
* **Efficient and Scalable AI:** Novel neural architectures, efficient attention mechanisms, transformers, state-space models, and recurrent networks; model compression, pruning, quantization, neural architecture search, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and efficient training and inference. Research also includes on-device AI, edge-cloud learning, distributed training, hardware-aware optimization, and compiler and kernel optimizations.
* **Learning, Perception, and Embodied AI:** Self-supervised, reinforcement, imitation, contrastive, and continual learning; few-shot learning, personalization, domain adaptation, and uncertainty estimation. Applications include computer vision, 3D perception, neural rendering, speech AI, autonomous driving, robotics, embodied intelligence, and human-AI interfaces.

  

Depending on the research project, internship responsibilities may include:

* Conducting original research, developing novel machine learning algorithms and architectures, and designing, training, and evaluating AI models to advance the state of the art.
* Developing efficient AI systems and software frameworks, including optimization for mobile, edge, and cloud platforms.
* Exploring emerging computing paradigms, including hardware-software co-design, compute-in-memory, and distributed or federated learning.
* Collaborating with researchers and engineers to prototype, validate, and communicate research findings, with opportunities to contribute to scientific publications and technology transfer.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
  
  

* 6+ months of experience developing and/or optimizing machine learning models, systems, platforms, or methods.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. If you’re excited about this kind of research, join us on an impactful journey of innovation at Prescient.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
* **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.

* **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.
* **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.
* **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

  

**The Opportunity**

  
  

Within AI for Drug Discovery, the Frontier Research team advances fundamental machine learning and statistics methods, motivated by real-world challenges in drug discovery. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. If you’re excited about this kind of research, join us on an impactful journey of innovation at Prescient.

* Must be pursuing, or have completed within the last 12 months, a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computational Biology, or related technical field, or have demonstrated equivalent research productivity.

**The Role**

We’re AV Frameworks within AV Platform Core at General Motors. We build the foundational frameworks that power robotics and autonomous capabilities across distributed compute — with a focus on inter-process communication (IPC), middleware, and developer experience that make complex systems reliable, observable, and fast. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver the core communication and runtime building blocks used by AV/Robotics applications on vehicles, on benches, and in simulation. You’ll work across C++ systems, Linux, and networking/IPC to achieve low-latency messaging, deterministic scheduling, and production-grade reliability at scale.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Own design and implementation of high-performance IPC and middleware primitives (publish/subscribe, shared memory, serialization, discovery, QoS).

* Drive latency, throughput, and determinism improvements through profiling, tracing, benchmarking, and targeted optimizations.

* Build developer-facing APIs, tooling, and documentation that improve ergonomics, correctness, and velocity for internal customers.

* Deliver platform-ready components with observability (metrics, logs, traces), robust fault handling, and reproducible performance characteristics.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with platform OS, drivers, safety, controls, perception, and tooling teams to integrate end-to-end solutions.

* Apply production rigor: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, soak), performance and regression gates, and rollout/rollback discipline.

Mentor engineers, contribute to design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering excellence.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years building systems-level software in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) or Rust on Linux.

* Deep knowledge of concurrency, memory management, lock-free or low-contention patterns, and performance profiling.

* Hands-on experience with IPC/messaging systems and distributed systems fundamentals (serialization, backpressure, flow control, QoS).

* Strong understanding of networking (sockets, TCP/UDP, multicast, NICs, buffers, MTU, packetization) and time synchronization concepts.

Proficiency with build and CI tooling (Bazel/Buck/CMake, test frameworks, artifact/versioning strategies).  

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Robotics/AV middleware: ROS 2, DDS, gRPC, ZeroMQ, eCAL, shared memory IPC.

jobs.description:
**Cobalt Assembly**

*Build, ship, and operate software with confidence.*

**Headquarters:** San Francisco, California  
**Industry:** Cloud infrastructure and developer tools

Cobalt Assembly develops a cloud platform that helps engineering teams build, deploy, monitor, and operate production software. Its customers include technology companies and large digital businesses that need reliable infrastructure without forcing every development team to manage complex cloud systems independently.

The company is recognized for technically demanding work, a high engineering bar, and products designed primarily for professional software developers.

**Software Engineer — Developer Platform**

**Location:** San Francisco, California  
**Work arrangement:** Hybrid — four office days, with Friday available for remote work  
**Employment:** Full-time, salaried and exempt  
**Schedule:** Monday through Friday  
**Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week  
**Base salary:** $180,000–$220,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level  
**Annual cash bonus:** Not offered for this position  
**Equity:** Initial grant valued at approximately $160,000–$320,000 over four years  
**Estimated annualized compensation:** $220,000–$300,000 at the initial grant-date equity value  
**Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Developer Platform  
**On-call:** Approximately one week every ten weeks

The role

Cobalt Assembly is hiring a Software Engineer to build the tools and services that other engineering teams use to develop, test, deploy, and monitor production applications.

You will work on internal APIs, deployment workflows, developer tooling, and shared cloud infrastructure. This is a mid-level individual-contributor position with ownership of meaningful projects, but it does not include direct reports.

What you’ll do

* Build services and APIs that support application deployment, configuration, and production operations.
* Improve developer workflows from local development through testing and release.
* Design reliable systems for service discovery, permissions, deployment history, and configuration management.
* Work with product engineers to identify recurring development problems and turn them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Improve platform observability, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Investigate production incidents and implement changes that prevent similar failures.
* Review code and technical proposals from engineers across the company.
* Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions.
* Join the platform on-call rotation after completing onboarding and readiness training.

What we’re looking for

* At least three years of professional software engineering experience.
* Production experience with Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
* Experience building backend services, APIs, or internal developer tools.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Understanding of testing, code review, version control, and continuous delivery.
* Ability to diagnose problems using logs, metrics, traces, and production data.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience owning a project from initial design through production release.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline is helpful but not required.

Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD systems, or developer-platform engineering is helpful but not required.

Technology

The platform primarily uses Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS. Candidates do not need experience with the entire stack and will receive time to learn unfamiliar components.

Compensation and equity

The base salary is determined by relevant experience, technical scope, interview performance, and internal leveling.

This position does not include an annual cash bonus. Instead, employees receive an equity grant that normally vests over four years, subject to the company’s equity plan and continued employment.

The stated equity value is calculated at the time of the grant. Its future value may increase or decrease and is not guaranteed. Equity should not be treated as cash salary.

* **Professional development:** $3,000 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and dedicated engineering-learning days.
* **Office and work support:** Company laptop and home-office equipment, lunch on office days, commuter reimbursement, and relocation assistance when approved.

Eligibility and complete plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation.

Schedule and on-call expectations

Most collaboration takes place between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Engineers may arrange the remainder of their schedule with their manager.

After onboarding, the engineer joins an on-call rotation approximately once every ten weeks. On-call engineers respond to urgent platform incidents outside regular hours. When substantial overnight work is required, the following workday’s schedule is adjusted.

What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform architecture, deliver a production contribution, and complete on-call readiness training.

Within six months, you should independently lead a platform improvement used by multiple engineering teams and demonstrate sound judgment during design reviews and production incidents.

jobs.description:
**About Zoox**

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

**About Our Contract Student Worker Program**

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

### **Role Overview**

Zoox is bringing its robotaxi service to cities across the US. Every new city needs depots to house and maintain the fleet, and pickup/dropoff locations at the places riders want to go most: hotels, airports, stadiums and event venues. In this role, you will own and grow the internal web tools that coordinate this rollout, giving teams a single, clear view of every site from planning to launch.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own the expansion-tracking web tools end to end, from feature request to release
* Build new views, dashboards, and workflows that help teams launch new cities and bring service to high-profile airports, venues, and hotels
* Develop and extend integrations with Jira so project status stays accurate and up to date
* Partner with operations and engineering teams to understand their needs and turn them into features
* Keep the tools reliable and easy to use as the number of sites grows

### **Required Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Experience working with REST APIs
* Comfortable with Git and code review
* Self-starter who takes ownership and works well independently
* Clear written and verbal communication

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience building web apps or dashboards end to end
* Familiarity with Jira or similar project-tracking tools
* Experience deploying web services
* Data visualization experience
* Interest in autonomous vehicles, operations, or scaling a product to new markets

### **Program Requirements**

* Comfortable with Git and code review
* Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and works well independently
* Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
* Clear written and verbal communication

**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
* Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
* Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
* Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
* Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
* Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

* Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

**Job Description**

General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences.

  

**About the Team**

Every autonomous-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data:

* Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use.
* Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural-language queries.
Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change.  

  

Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet-operations tools and AI-assisted triage. We share one goal: shorten the loop from collecting data, to understanding it, to fixing the vehicle.

  

**About the Role**

Our senior engineers don't wait for a spec. Demand for our tools outpaces any roadmap, so the most valuable thing you'll do is decide what to build. That means finding the problem that's quietly costing engineers hours every week, designing the tool that removes it, and shipping it. You'll own a major part of the data lifecycle end to end, such as how engineers search and mine data, or how they analyze and debug it. You'll also help connect cataloging, search, and analysis into one workflow.

* Build high-performance tools for analyzing what happened, with synchronized replay of camera video, lidar, 3D scenes, plots, and maps. Engineers use them to triage and diagnose issues, to validate new software changes, and to debug live in the vehicle during testing.
* Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped. Write requirements and design docs that weigh options, build consensus with stakeholders, and deliver iteratively so users are unblocked early.
* Serve as technical lead for a multi-project workstream. Plan and break down the work, delegate, hold a high bar in design and code reviews, and guide engineers across GM who contribute to our tools.
* Keep tools fast and reliable in production, and raise the bar for the team's engineering systems: tests, CI speed, developer experience, observability, and on-call.
Mentor engineers, and use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to multiply what a small team can deliver.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building complex, data-intensive web applications with TypeScript/JavaScript and React.
* A track record of spotting an unmet user need yourself, building the tool or feature that addressed it, and driving it to real adoption.
* Hands-on experience building on both SQL and vector databases, including data modeling, indexing, and query performance (e.g., PostgreSQL or BigQuery, and Vespa, Milvus, pgvector, or OpenSearch).
* Comfort working across the stack, designing APIs and building services in Node.js or Python.

* Demonstrated technical leadership: leading multi-person projects, writing design docs, and driving decisions across teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical users whose needs differ widely, from perception researchers to test operators.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Depth in search and retrieval: multimodal embeddings (e.g., CLIP- or SigLIP-style image–text models), hybrid ranking that blends vector similarity with structured filters, and measuring search relevance.
* Building LLM-, VLM-, or agent-based features into products, and fluency with AI-assisted development tools.

* Robotics or AV data: ROS/ROS 2, rosbag or MCAP, Protobuf, and Apache Arrow or Parquet, plus visualizing or debugging time-series sensor data (camera, lidar, radar).

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

We are the team behind the software that runs our fleet of Tesla’s utility-scale battery energy storage sites. Our application — the Site Controller — runs at the edge on embedded Linux and orchestrates the devices on a site (batteries, power meters, and more), manages configuration and redundancy, integrates with external equipment, and reliably pushes field telemetry up to the Tesla cloud. Our software is primarily written in Golang and Rust, though other strong object-oriented languages are welcome.

We are seeking a talented, motivated, and independent engineer to join the team and contribute to meaningful pieces of that stack, from implementing features through to debugging and supporting deployments. The ideal candidate will be proficient in an object-oriented language (Go, Rust, or another strong OOP language), have solid software fundamentals, and an eagerness to keep learning in an ever-evolving environment.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and own application-layer software for the Industrial Energy Site Controller on embedded Linux — settings management, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and external communications
* Contribute to the edge/on-device telemetry software — collecting, buffering, and reliably pushing field data up to the Tesla cloud (we build the device side, not the cloud backend)
Integrate the Site Controller with external, non-Tesla systems, building edge proxy/bridge services (e.g. OPC UA* CODESYS) that abstract third-party equipment behind a consistent interface
* Help build redundancy and high-availability into the site controller — failover, data/telemetry integrity, and resilient comms paths

* Experience integrating with industrial/utility protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA, CAN) — or a demonstrated ability to pick up unfamiliar external protocols quickly
* Experience building on-device/edge data collection and ingestion on resource-constrained systems — reliable buffering and delivery to a backend over unreliable field networks (or strong adjacent experience and a willingness to learn)

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Region:** North America, all regions

### **The Role**

SDVI’s DevOps team keeps customer environments provisioned, up to date, and running. Those environments process content for television and streaming services around the world. The team works with the rest of Engineering to design, build, launch, and maintain whole-system deployments.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be a primary owner of major parts of our infrastructure and drive projects with minimal direction. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure that television and streaming services depend on every day, at a company small enough that your decisions are visible and impactful. When production issues happen, you’ll take the lead through resolution, root cause analysis, and follow-up work.

### **What You’ll Work On**

* Own major parts of a growing fleet of over 10,000 cloud compute instances serving dozens of customer environments
* Configure and provision the other AWS building blocks that support running Rally environments
* Drive the design and expansion of deployment automation for a growing set of customer environments
* Monitor the health and security of SDVI infrastructure, and work with Engineering to decide when new monitoring and alerting tools are worth building, then build and maintain them
* Automate creation of Windows and Linux AMIs so third-party tools can scale quickly
* Build and maintain tools that let other developers make infrastructure changes themselves
* Lead production incident response, keep all stakeholders informed, and lead root cause analysis, including defining and assigning follow-up work
* Manage the cost of deployed Rally infrastructure, and look for ways to make it more efficient
* Improve the practices and tools the team uses
* Take part in a paid after-hours on-call rotation with the Support Engineering and DevOps teams

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped infrastructure changes to production, know how our customer environments are deployed end to end, have joined the on-call rotation, and are driving at least one project.
* **First year.** You’re a primary owner of a major part of our deployment or monitoring infrastructure, you’ve led root cause analysis on production incidents, and you’ve made a measurable improvement to reliability or cost.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* Extensive experience owning production systems, and an understanding of the responsibility that comes with access to them
* Strong Python and bash skills, and the ability to read code in most other languages
* Deep experience building and maintaining infrastructure on a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms, microservice-based systems, and containerized software
* Comfort configuring both Linux and Windows server environments
* Enough SQL to find your way around a database console and write basic queries
* Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis
* Curiosity about new infrastructure, tools, and technologies, and the discipline to learn them in depth
* The ability to explain deeply technical topics to non-technical audiences, and to adjust how you communicate for customers, management, or peers

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with AWS specifically
* Experience with PowerShell
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools
* Familiarity with professional media formats and tools, such as codecs, container formats, and media encoders

If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you.

### **How We Work**

* **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team.
* **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it.
* **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on.
* **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version.

### **How We Use AI**

AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day-to-day experiences to separate signal from noise.

Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity.

This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed.

### **Logistics**

* This is a remote role. You should be based in the United States, and either in the Eastern time zone or able to commit to working East Coast hours
* This role includes a paid after-hours on-call rotation
* Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role
* Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview

### **Compensation and Benefits**

*Salary range $140,000 to $185,000*

*Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US-applicable only.*

### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:**

* You are looking for your next big challenge
* You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually
* You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you

**About Etched**

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Every Etched system starts its life in a lab. Before a rack-scale inference product reaches a customer, it goes through bring-up, validation, and testing in our factories, labs, or data centers, and each of those environments needs networked, provisioned, monitored infrastructure that is ready before the hardware arrives. The Infra Labs team builds and runs that infrastructure.

As an Infrastructure Engineer on Infra Labs, you will own the racks and server infrastructure across Etched's labs and data center sites, from our office lab at Santana Row to our new hardware facility in Milpitas and our Bay Area colocation footprint. Once our forward-deployed engineers physically install a system, you take it from there: getting it onto the network, provisioned, connected to the storage and compute services it depends on, observable, and healthy through bring-up and testing. You'll support our current rack-scale systems, stand up labs for our next-generation racks and next-generation silicon, and help build the internal deployments that let us run our systems the way our customers do.

This is not a cloud role, and it is not a production SRE role. It is hands-on, full-stack infrastructure delivery in environments that change every week. * Run shared lab compute: help our Infrastructure Team members manage the Slurm cluster that lets engineers reserve accelerator systems, including partitions, reservations, and maintenance drains, and expand storage and compute as programs grow.

* Write infrastructure automation in Ansible and Python through reviewed, tested pull requests, and build tooling that serves both tightly controlled environments and the varied needs of individual lab teams.
* Manage software releases and changes on lab systems under change control, respond to incidents, and keep runbooks, inventory, and design records current as you work.

---------------------------

* Plan and build lab infrastructure for the bring-up of our next-generation silicon, so that systems are reachable and imaged the day engineering samples arrive.
* Take a new colocation cage from empty to live: coordinate cross-connects and circuits, configure top-of-rack switches and uplinks, and hand racks over ready for internal workloads.
* Build a link- and hardware-health pipeline that spots rising bit error rates, CRC errors, and flapping links, and points to the right fix: clean an optic, swap a cable, or replace a NIC.
* Design an asset and inventory workflow that ties serial numbers, MAC and IP addresses, and rack locations together so every repair and RMA is traceable.
* Build high-throughput NVMe and NFS storage for loading model weights across lab racks, with documented layouts and benchmarks.
* Move lab telemetry and firmware workflows onto standard Redfish and OpenBMC interfaces as our hardware platforms adopt them.

* Are comfortable across every layer of a rack: servers, power circuits and PDUs, Linux, networking,

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a small engineering team developing autonomous systems in the defense technology sector. As a senior individual contributor, you will own the precision motion controls stack, from control-loop architecture and state estimation to integration and validation on real hardware.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and tune precision pointing and tracking control loops, including closed-loop operation from sensor input to actuator commands at hundreds of hertz.
* Develop state estimation and sensor fusion using IMU, encoder, and vision feedback.
* Identify and model gimbal, mount, and actuator dynamics, and compensate for resonance, backlash, friction, saturation, and other nonlinearities.
* Build and maintain controls simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure to validate designs and reduce the sim-to-real gap.
* Integrate controls with tracking systems and characterize performance on physical hardware in laboratory and field settings.
* Document controls architecture, tuning approaches, and engineering standards.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 4 years of robotics experience, including hands-on design and tuning of closed-loop controllers on motion hardware such as servo drives, brushless motors, encoders, and IMUs.
* Strong grounding in classical and state-space control, including LQR and MPC, with experience applying control methods to physical systems.
* Practical state-estimation experience, such as Kalman, EKF, UKF, or complementary filters, and sensor fusion on hardware.
* Experience with system identification, frequency-domain tuning, resonance characterization, and real-time control-loop latency and jitter.
* Modern C++ for real-time control, plus Python or MATLAB/Simulink for modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Experience validating simulations against real hardware and working across mechanical, electrical, and software disciplines.
* Background in precision motion, gimbals, target tracking, aerospace, or other related control systems is valuable.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California.

Compensation Range: $180K - $200K

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value.  
  
Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end:  
  

* Offline feature engineering: a multi-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve.
* Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue.
* Online feature store and feature retrieval: low-latency, high-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real-time ad ranking.
* Next-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster.

  
As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide
* Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large-scale training and real-time inference systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production
* Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces
* Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers

  
A day in the life  
You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization.  
  
About the team  
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.
  
  
We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI-assisted development.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of building large-scale machine-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience
* 1+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
