jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**

New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City.

**The Role**

Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate.

**What You'll Do**

* Fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation.
* Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model.
* Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise.
* Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production.
* Experiment with supervised fine-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks.
* Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference.
* Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on.
* Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training.
* Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**

* Have fine-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding.
* Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting.
* Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards.
* Have contributed to open-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results.

**Don't Apply If...**

* Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls.
* You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day.
* You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production.
* You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost.

Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm.
* Company-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us.
* Non-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.  
  
**This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

**Your team**
-------------

You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about.

Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses.

Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access.

The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly.

**Your mission**
----------------

As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Publisher integrations**

* Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers.
* Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory.
* Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend.

**Deals & catalog**

* Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API.
* Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe.
* Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it.

**Supply tooling & publisher platform**

* Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend.
* Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production.
* Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design.
* Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow.
* Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break.
* Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy.
* Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables.
* Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts.
* Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST.
* Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels).
* Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar).
* Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting.

**Our Values**
--------------

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

**What We Offer**

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Podium Automation is reimagining industrial control panel manufacturing through software-enabled design and automated fabrication. We're building technology to create a new industrial supply chain - reducing lead times for critical electrical equipment from months to days. We've raised over $23M from top-tier investors including Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Transition Ventures, Sunflower Capital, Banter Capital, and SV Angel.

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** who is excited to invent new technology in the built world. You will own and lead development of our customer portal, Glass, which provides transparency into the state of customer projects and builds a bridge between Podium engineering and stakeholders.

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Podium strives to streamline the process by which a panel is designed and built. But building physical things is hard: requirements change and priorities shift as new information becomes available. Key to reducing the end-to-end ship time is tightening the loop between Podium and our customers.

We’re building, and you will own, a customer-first application that:

* Onboards new customers to Podium
* Houses schematic drawings and collects engineering feedback
* Exposes the state of a build on the floor and enables factory acceptance testing
* Notifies users, both internal and external, when action is needed

Underlying the portal is accurate tracking of material, orders, and customer requirements. Odoo, our ERP solution, is the source truth. Odoo is open source and designed to be extended. You will be our Odoo development expert, supporting the Glass portal and the many other initiatives that rely on our ERP.

**Our Stack:** We use TypeScript, Postgres, SQL Server, HTMX, Docker, Terraform, and AWS. As the owner of this domain, you have the latitude to adopt whatever tools, frameworks, models, or services best fit the problem.

**What You'll Do**

* **Platform Ownership:** Own the technical roadmap and expansion of Glass.
* **Odoo Development:** Build upon Odoo to add data, expose new endpoints, and refine Odoo internals to better align with our business.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with electrical engineers, sales, and our procurement team. Serve as the technical leader for this domain and a mentor for other engineers.
* **Strategic Growth:** Proactively identify and pursue new opportunities to improve the business through the application of technology. We are a software-enabled hardware company, and when an unexpected opportunity presents itself we take it.

**Who You Are**

There are 4 values that all Podium employees are expected to demonstrate (albeit imperfectly):

* Win for the customer. We sit on the same side of the table as our customers - their wins are our wins. We’re building the vendor we always wished we had.
* Default to transparency. We believe in honesty, transparency, and kindness. It’s about how you get things done and not just what gets done.
* Speed is a feature. We move fast and take ownership. Don’t let perfect be the enemy of good.
* Win and lose as a team. Individuals drive inputs, teams drive outputs. We celebrate success together but aren’t afraid to fail and iterate. We own outcomes together and don’t deflect blame.

  **What We’re Looking For**

  + 5+ years of software engineering experience
  + 1+ years experience developing on Odoo
  + Fluency in TypeScript
  + Commitment to a highly collaborative work environment full of people who like to roll up their sleeves, want a voice, want to build rather than inherit, and share in the results.on-site work environment
  + Available to work in-person in Brooklyn, NY (in person, 5 days/week)

  **Nice To Have**

  + Experience with the Node.js or Deno runtime environment
  + Familiarity with industrial controls or electrical design

  Please note that sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

Compensation Range: $150K - $190K

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3
jobs.description:
MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

### **What you will do**

* Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them
* Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds
* Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for
* Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics
* Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
* Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause
* Contribute integrations to shared SDKs, command-line tools, and agent frameworks used by other teams
* Collaborate with product managers, platform engineers, and partner teams on scoped initiatives, and break work into incremental deliverables
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that raise the quality of the team's work
* Interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns

### **What you bring**

Required

* At least four years of experience building and operating production software services
* Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript, with the judgment to work effectively in more than one
* Experience designing APIs or service interfaces, including versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility
* Practical experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, API keys, or service-to-service identity
* Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery, and debugging in distributed systems
* Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
* A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk

Preferred

* Experience building tool or integration surfaces for AI agents or large language models, including execution context, tool schemas, or guardrails against nondeterministic behavior
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol or a comparable agent-to-tool integration standard
* Experience shipping developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or local servers that run inside customer-managed environments
* Familiarity with application modernization, relational databases, MongoDB, or automated code transformation
* Experience working with customers or field teams on integration and deployment issues
* Experience mentoring engineers or interns and contributing to technical hiring

Candidates with additional relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles.

### **What success looks like**

* **OpenStack Core Competency:** Hands-on experience working with or maintaining OpenStack ecosystems in production or large-scale staging environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to cloud-native technologies and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Python/Bash scripting).

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

**The Team**
------------

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

**Core Principles**
-------------------

### **Taste: Craft beautiful experiences.**

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

### **Obsession: Commit unreasonably.**

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

### **Action: Get it done.**

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

**Your Role**
-------------

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Rox, you’ll work directly with the world’s top revenue teams to bring AI native workflows to life. This is a high ownership, technical role with a platform engineering focus: onboarding, solution design, deep product adoption, and building durable integrations into complex customer environments.

You’ll lead everything from technical scoping and integration to live demos, trainings, and user activation. Whether you’re mapping complex workflows, writing Python and SQL to support a customer use case, designing systems that fit into large scale IT organizations, or feeding insights into product, you’ll be instrumental in helping users realize value quickly.

You’ll collaborate across sales, product, and platform engineering to shape how Rox is delivered to customers. This is not a traditional CS role. It’s a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who wants to help define how humans and AI agents work together in practice.

If you’re curious, technical, and obsessed with customer outcomes, we’d love to work with you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own post-sale onboarding end-to-end, ensuring every user finds value from their first call onward
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, proactively engaging users and mapping their workflows to Rox
* Deliver engaging demos, trainings, and live solutioning sessions (remote + in-person)
* Run integration and scoping sessions with GTM and RevOps teams to enable high-impact POCs
* Capture product feedback and use cases to inform roadmap and strategic direction
* Collaborate cross-functionally to build internal documentation, playbooks, and enablement content
* Drive user activation and expansion by delivering compelling value narratives

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 1+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, supporting technical customer relationships (pre- or post-sale)
* Strong execution mindset: you thrive in fast-paced environments and move with urgency
* Background in distributed systems
* Understanding of large scale IT organizations
* Programming experience in Python, plus SQL for working with large datasets
* Fluent in AI native programming and system design
* Familiarity with GTM methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICED) and how users apply them
* Excited to work across onboarding, sales engineering, and customer success in a hybrid role
* Strong communication skills and comfort presenting to both technical and business stakeholders
* Bias toward scaling yourself through process, tooling, and collaboration
* Curious and customer-obsessed: you’re always learning and looking for ways to delight users
* Be located in or willing to relocate to New York

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
* Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents
* Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability
* 401(k) with automatic enrollment

jobs.title: Computational Biologist II, Tempus Discover
jobs.description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

**Computational Biologist II, Tempus Discover**
-----------------------------------------------

Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

**About this position**

We are looking for a highly analytical, self-motivated and solution-oriented scientist with a strong background in analyzing large-scale, multi-omic molecular and real-world clinical datasets to join our Discover Data Science team supporting external research collaborations. In this role, you will work directly with the Tempus Medical Sciences Team and oncology research leaders to understand their goals and translate their scientific questions into insight generation. Your work will directly enhance Tempus’ research capabilities and empower our teams and partners to generate actionable insights for patient care.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and contribute to research projects in support of research initiatives within R&D and Medical Affairs, leveraging large-scale real-world clinical and multi-omic molecular data.
* Present insights from research studies to external research partners through formal presentations and communicate research findings effectively.
* Stay updated on methodological advancements in real-world studies, next generation sequencing (DNA/RNA) and oncology guidelines.
* Communicate analytical results, and scientific findings clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical and genomics expertise.
* Participate in publications and podium activities.

**Required Experience:**

* 1+ years experience in industry or academia, following completion of PhD degree in quantitative NGS-related disciplines (e.g. Computational Biology, Genetics, or similar). Alternatively, a PhD in computational biology with a strong record of multi-omic, high-throughput sequencing data analysis.
* Experience deriving oncology-specific clinical insights using genomic and/or real-world data and deriving real-world endpoints using time-to-event methodologies within a retrospective database.
* Excellent project management skills, with proven ability to collaborate with teams of multi-disciplinary scientists to define and execute analysis plans to address scientific questions using omics datasets (genomics, transcriptomics).
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment and willing to shift priorities seamlessly.
* A collaborative mindset, coupled with a genuine eagerness to learn and a steadfast dedication to maintaining integrity in all endeavors.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience integrating molecular data with real-world evidence and longitudinal clinical outcomes.
Hands-on experience applying machine learning techniques or foundation models (FMs) to complex biomedical or multi-omic datasets.  

CHI: $90,000-$135,000 NYC/SF: $100,000-$150,000

The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  

### **About Us**

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
new_jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesData Science & Analytics ID: 48346

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
* **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
* **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
* **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.
* **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.
* **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.
* **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics.
* **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.

You have (at least some of) the following:

* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. **The Opportunity**

  
  

Within AI for Drug Discovery, the Frontier Research team advances fundamental machine learning and statistics methods, motivated by real-world challenges in drug discovery. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. If you’re excited about this kind of research, join us on an impactful journey of innovation at Prescient.

new_jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Region:** North America, all regions

### **The Role**

SDVI’s DevOps team keeps customer environments provisioned, up to date, and running. Those environments process content for television and streaming services around the world. The team works with the rest of Engineering to design, build, launch, and maintain whole-system deployments.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be a primary owner of major parts of our infrastructure and drive projects with minimal direction. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure that television and streaming services depend on every day, at a company small enough that your decisions are visible and impactful. When production issues happen, you’ll take the lead through resolution, root cause analysis, and follow-up work.

### **What You’ll Work On**

* Own major parts of a growing fleet of over 10,000 cloud compute instances serving dozens of customer environments
* Configure and provision the other AWS building blocks that support running Rally environments
* Drive the design and expansion of deployment automation for a growing set of customer environments
* Monitor the health and security of SDVI infrastructure, and work with Engineering to decide when new monitoring and alerting tools are worth building, then build and maintain them
* Automate creation of Windows and Linux AMIs so third-party tools can scale quickly
* Build and maintain tools that let other developers make infrastructure changes themselves
* Lead production incident response, keep all stakeholders informed, and lead root cause analysis, including defining and assigning follow-up work
* Manage the cost of deployed Rally infrastructure, and look for ways to make it more efficient
* Improve the practices and tools the team uses
* Take part in a paid after-hours on-call rotation with the Support Engineering and DevOps teams

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped infrastructure changes to production, know how our customer environments are deployed end to end, have joined the on-call rotation, and are driving at least one project.
* **First year.** You’re a primary owner of a major part of our deployment or monitoring infrastructure, you’ve led root cause analysis on production incidents, and you’ve made a measurable improvement to reliability or cost.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* Extensive experience owning production systems, and an understanding of the responsibility that comes with access to them
* Strong Python and bash skills, and the ability to read code in most other languages
* Deep experience building and maintaining infrastructure on a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms, microservice-based systems, and containerized software
* Comfort configuring both Linux and Windows server environments
* Enough SQL to find your way around a database console and write basic queries
* Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis
* Curiosity about new infrastructure, tools, and technologies, and the discipline to learn them in depth
* The ability to explain deeply technical topics to non-technical audiences, and to adjust how you communicate for customers, management, or peers

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with AWS specifically
* Experience with PowerShell
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools
* Familiarity with professional media formats and tools, such as codecs, container formats, and media encoders

If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you.

### **How We Work**

* **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team.
* **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it.
* **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on.
* **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version.

### **How We Use AI**

AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day-to-day experiences to separate signal from noise.

Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity.

This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed.

### **Logistics**

* This is a remote role. You should be based in the United States, and either in the Eastern time zone or able to commit to working East Coast hours
* This role includes a paid after-hours on-call rotation
* Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role
* Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview

### **Compensation and Benefits**

*Salary range $140,000 to $185,000*

*Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US-applicable only.*

### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:**

* You are looking for your next big challenge
* You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually
* You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you

**About Etched**

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Every Etched system starts its life in a lab. Before a rack-scale inference product reaches a customer, it goes through bring-up, validation, and testing in our factories, labs, or data centers, and each of those environments needs networked, provisioned, monitored infrastructure that is ready before the hardware arrives. The Infra Labs team builds and runs that infrastructure.

As an Infrastructure Engineer on Infra Labs, you will own the racks and server infrastructure across Etched's labs and data center sites, from our office lab at Santana Row to our new hardware facility in Milpitas and our Bay Area colocation footprint. Once our forward-deployed engineers physically install a system, you take it from there: getting it onto the network, provisioned, connected to the storage and compute services it depends on, observable, and healthy through bring-up and testing. You'll support our current rack-scale systems, stand up labs for our next-generation racks and next-generation silicon, and help build the internal deployments that let us run our systems the way our customers do.

This is not a cloud role, and it is not a production SRE role. It is hands-on, full-stack infrastructure delivery in environments that change every week. One week you might rebuild a network-boot provisioning flow for a new server type, chase a NIC firmware or PCIe issue on a liquid-cooled development kit, and rack and cable a new lab row. You'll work alongside Lab Operations, Supercomputing, and Deployment teams to figure out what needs to be built, and then build it with scale in mind from day one: we are designing for gigawatt-scale inference deployments, not a handful of racks.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Deliver full-stack infrastructure for new lab and data center sites: compute, networking, storage, and the core services (DHCP, DNS, zero-touch provisioning, NFS) that need to be in place before hardware arrives.
* Build and maintain bare-metal provisioning for servers, development kits, rack management controllers, and switches, using PXE/iPXE, DHCP, BMC/Redfish-driven imaging, and golden images, so that a newly racked system comes up with no hands on the keyboard.
* Troubleshoot Linux hosts end-to-end on custom and early-stage hardware: kernel, PCIe, NIC driver and firmware, bonding, storage, boot, and power issues. Drive each one to the root cause and write it up.
* Bring racks onto the network: top-of-rack and uplink configuration, VLAN and IP planning, optics and cabling, in partnership with our network engineers.
* Diagnose physical-layer and hardware faults such as link flaps, CRC errors, dirty or failed optics, power faults, and coolant leaks, and coordinate repairs and RMAs with lab staff and vendors.
* Run shared lab compute: help our Infrastructure Team members manage the Slurm cluster that lets engineers reserve accelerator systems, including partitions, reservations, and maintenance drains, and expand storage and compute as programs grow.
* Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana) to every lab rack, with dashboards and alerts for health, power, and link status across sites.
* Write infrastructure automation in Ansible and Python through reviewed, tested pull requests, and build tooling that serves both tightly controlled environments and the varied needs of individual lab teams.
* Manage software releases and changes on lab systems under change control, respond to incidents, and keep runbooks, inventory, and design records current as you work.

**Representative Projects**
---------------------------

* Stand up the full infrastructure for our Milpitas hardware facility as it comes online for next-generation rack validation: network, provisioning, storage, telemetry, and access, ready before the first engineering cabinets are built.
* Build a portable, containerized provisioning stack (DHCP, PXE, HTTP, ZTP) that can be dropped into a new lab or rack to bring up servers and switches straight off the network.
* Plan and build lab infrastructure for the bring-up of our next-generation silicon, so that systems are reachable and imaged the day engineering samples arrive.
* Take a new colocation cage from empty to live: coordinate cross-connects and circuits, configure top-of-rack switches and uplinks, and hand racks over ready for internal workloads.
* Build a link- and hardware-health pipeline that spots rising bit error rates, CRC errors, and flapping links, and points to the right fix: clean an optic, swap a cable, or replace a NIC.
* Design an asset and inventory workflow that ties serial numbers, MAC and IP addresses, and rack locations together so every repair and RMA is traceable.
* Build high-throughput NVMe and NFS storage for loading model weights across lab racks, with documented layouts and benchmarks.
* Move lab telemetry and firmware workflows onto standard Redfish and OpenBMC interfaces as our hardware platforms adopt them.

**You may be a good fit if you**
--------------------------------

* Have 4+ years of hands-on infrastructure, data center systems, or bare-metal operations experience in on-prem environments where you physically touched the hardware.
* Are comfortable across every layer of a rack: servers, power circuits and PDUs, Linux, networking,

new_jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**

New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City.

**The Role**

Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate.

**What You'll Do**

* Fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation.
* Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model.
* Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise.
* Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production.
* Experiment with supervised fine-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks.
* Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference.
* Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on.
* Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training.
* Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**

* Have fine-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding.
* Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting.
* Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards.
* Have contributed to open-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results.

**Don't Apply If...**

* Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls.
* You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day.
* You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production.
* You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost.

Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm.
* Company-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us.
* Non-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement.

MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.

The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.

We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

### **What you will do**

* Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them
* Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds
* Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for
* Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics
* Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
* Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause

Required

* Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript, with the judgment to work effectively in more than one
* Experience designing APIs or service interfaces, including versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility
* Practical experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, API keys, or service-to-service identity
* Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery, and debugging in distributed systems
* Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
* A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk

* Familiarity with application modernization, relational databases, MongoDB, or automated code transformation

* Experience mentoring engineers or interns and contributing to technical hiring

Candidates with additional relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles.

In your first month

* Ship small, well-scoped integration fixes and contribute effectively to code reviews.

new_jobs.title: Computational Biologist II, Tempus Discover
new_jobs.description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

**Computational Biologist II, Tempus Discover**
-----------------------------------------------

Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

**About this position**

We are looking for a highly analytical, self-motivated and solution-oriented scientist with a strong background in analyzing large-scale, multi-omic molecular and real-world clinical datasets to join our Discover Data Science team supporting external research collaborations. In this role, you will work directly with the Tempus Medical Sciences Team and oncology research leaders to understand their goals and translate their scientific questions into insight generation. Your work will directly enhance Tempus’ research capabilities and empower our teams and partners to generate actionable insights for patient care.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and contribute to research projects in support of research initiatives within R&D and Medical Affairs, leveraging large-scale real-world clinical and multi-omic molecular data.
* Present insights from research studies to external research partners through formal presentations and communicate research findings effectively.
* Stay updated on methodological advancements in real-world studies, next generation sequencing (DNA/RNA) and oncology guidelines.
* Communicate analytical results, and scientific findings clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical and genomics expertise.
* Participate in publications and podium activities.

**Required Experience:**

* 1+ years experience in industry or academia, following completion of PhD degree in quantitative NGS-related disciplines (e.g. Computational Biology, Genetics, or similar). Alternatively, a PhD in computational biology with a strong record of multi-omic, high-throughput sequencing data analysis.
* Experience deriving oncology-specific clinical insights using genomic and/or real-world data and deriving real-world endpoints using time-to-event methodologies within a retrospective database.
* Excellent project management skills, with proven ability to collaborate with teams of multi-disciplinary scientists to define and execute analysis plans to address scientific questions using omics datasets (genomics, transcriptomics).
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment and willing to shift priorities seamlessly.
* A collaborative mindset, coupled with a genuine eagerness to learn and a steadfast dedication to maintaining integrity in all endeavors.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience integrating molecular data with real-world evidence and longitudinal clinical outcomes.
Hands-on experience applying machine learning techniques or foundation models (FMs) to complex biomedical or multi-omic datasets.  

CHI: $90,000-$135,000 NYC/SF: $100,000-$150,000

The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  

### **About Us**

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

### **Why Work Here?**

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.
